CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CoreCustomerAccount_DEP
AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccount AS (

SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BDG.ACCT_NUM AS AccountNumber
	,BDG.ACCT_OWNERSHIP AS AccountOwnershipId
	,BDG.ACCT_RPT_CODE AS AccountReportCode
	,BDG.ACCT_CLS_FLG AS ClosedAccountIndicator
	,BDG.CHQ_ALWD_FLG AS ChequeAllowedIndicator
	,BDG.PB_PS_CODE AS PassbookPassSheetCode
	,BDG.SERV_CHRG_COLL_FLG AS CollectServiceChargeIndicator
	,BDG.ACCT_TURNOVER_DET_FLG AS AccountTurnoverDetailsEnabledIndicator
	,BDG.NOM_AVAILABLE_FLG AS NominationAvailableIndicator
	,BDG.ACCT_LOCN_CODE AS AccountLocationCodeId
	,BDG.INT_PAID_FLG AS InterestPaidIndicator
	,BDG.INT_COLL_FLG AS InterestCollectedIndicator
	,BDG.HASHED_NO AS AccountAmountInfo
	,BDG.LIMIT_B2KID AS LimitB2KId
	,BDG.DRWNG_POWER_IND AS DrawingPowerIndicator
	,BDG.DRWNG_POWER_PCNT AS DrawingPowerPercentage
	,BDG.MICR_CHQ_CHRG_COLL_FLG AS MicrChequeChargeCollectionIndicator
	,BDG.LAST_TURNOVER_DATE AS LastTurnoverDate
	,BDG.NOTIONAL_RATE AS NotionalRate
	,BDG.NOTIONAL_RATE_CODE AS NotionalRateId
	,BDG.FD_REF_NUM AS ForeignDepartmentReferenceNumber
	,BDG.ANW_NON_CUST_ALWD_FLG AS AnywhereNonCustAllowedIndicator
	,BDG.ACCT_CLASSIFICATION_FLG AS AccountClassificationId
	,BDG.SYSTEM_ONLY_ACCT_FLG AS SystemOnlyAccountIndicator
	,BDG.SINGLE_TRAN_FLG AS SingleTransactionIndicator
	,BDG.INTER_SOL_ACCESS_FLG AS InterBranchAccessIndicator
	,BDG.PURGE_ALLOWED_FLG AS PurgeAllowedIndicator
	,BDG.MIN_VALUE_DATE AS MinimumValueDate
	,BDG.SWIFT_ALLOWED_FLG AS SwiftAllowedIndicator
	,BDG.DACC_LIM_PCNT AS DaccLimitPercentage
	,BDG.DACC_LIM_ABS AS DaccAbsoluteLimitAmount
	,BDG.CHRG_LEVEL_CODE AS ChargeLevelCode
	,BDG.ACCT_CLS_CHRG_PEND_VERF AS AccountClosureCharges
	,BDG.PARTITIONED_FLG AS PartitionedIndicator
	,BDG.PBF_DOWNLOAD_FLG AS PdbDownloadIndicator
	,BDG.PBF_DELINK_DATE AS PbfDelinkDate
	,BDG.INT_ADJ_FOR_DEDUCTION_FLG AS InterestAdjustmentForDeductionIndicator
	,BDG.NATIVE_LANG_NAME AS NativeLanguageName
	,BDG.NAT_LANG_TITLE_CODE AS NativeLanguageTitleCode
	,BDG.LANG_CODE AS LanguageId
	,BDG.POOL_ID AS PoolId
	,BDG.ALLOW_SWEEPS AS SweepFacilityAllowedIndicator
	,BDG.ORDER_OF_UTILISATION AS OrderOfUtilization
	,BDG.DSA_PENAL_FLG AS DsaPenalIndicator
	,BDG.PRODUCT_GROUP AS ProductGroupId
	,BDG.ACCT_CREATION_MODE AS AccountCreationModeId
	,BDG.DAFA_LIM_PCNT AS DafaLimitPercentage
	,BDG.IS_LOAN_AGNST_CLTRL_FLG AS LoanAgainstColateralIndicator
	,BDG.PREFERRED_CAL_BASE AS PreferredCalendarBase
	,BDG.ADDITIONAL_CAL_BASE AS AdditionalCalendarBase
	,BDG.MUD_POOL_ACCT_FLG AS MudarabahPoolAccountIndicator
	,BDG.ALT1_ACCT_NAME AS AlternativeAccountName
	,BDG.EXTERNAL_PRICING_FLG AS ExternalPricingId
	,BDG.ACCT_MOD_FLG AS AccountModIndicator
	,BDG.CHQ_PROV_BY_BANK_FLG AS ChequeProvidedByBankIndicator
	,BDG.CHQ_VAL_PRD_MNTH AS ChequeValidityPeriodMonths
	,BDG.CHQ_VAL_PRD_DAY AS ChequeValidityPeriodDays
	,BDG.ACCT_OWNERSHIP_XFER_AGE AS AccountOwnershipTransferAge
	,BDG.OD_PROT_ALWD AS CourtesyOverdraftIndicator
	,BDG.REQ_MIN_DIS_AMT AS RequiredMinimumDistributionAmount
	,BDG.REQ_MIN_DIS_TENOR AS RequiredMinimumDistributionTenor
	,BDG.DISP_BLOCK_AMT AS BlockedAmount
	,BDG.CONS_BAL_FLG AS ConsolidatedBalanceIndicator
	,BDG.DR_INT_PRENOTE_REQ_FLG AS DebitInterestPrenotificationRequiredIndicator
	,BDG.DR_INT_PRENOTE_PERIOD AS DebitInterestPrenotificationPeriod
	,BDG.CHRG_PRENOTIFICATION_FLG AS ChargePrenotificationIndicator
	,BDG.TARGET_BAL_FOR_SWEEPS AS TargetBalanceForSweeps
	,BDG.CHECK_FUNDS_AVAIL_SET AS CheckFundsAvailableSetId
	,BDG.CHQ_REORDER_ALWD_FLG AS ChequeReorderAllowedIndicator
	,BDG.DR_INT_METHOD AS DebitInterestMethodId
	,BDG.COLL_CHRG_FOR_SWP_REG AS CollectChargesForSweepsRegularizationIndicator

	,BDGAC.SIG_MANDATE_FREE_TEXT_3 AS SignatureMandate3
	,BDGAC.SECURITY_INDICATOR AS SecuredExposurePercentage
	,BDGAC.DEBT_SENIORITY AS DebtSeniorityTypeId
	,BDGAC.SECURITY_CODE AS SecurityTypeId

	,BDGAC.INT_CR_ACCT_FLG AS InterestCreditAccountIndicator
	,NULL AS PastDueIndicator
	,NULL AS DemandPastDueCounter
	,BDGAC.DAILY_COMP_INT_FLG AS DailyCompoundingInterestIndicator
	,BDGAC.COMP_DATE_FLG AS CompoundingRestIndicator
	,BDGAC.RULE_CODE AS RuleId
	,BDGAC.SECURED_FLG AS SecuredFacilityIndicator
	,BDGAC.MARKUP_INT_RATE_APPL_FLG AS MarkupInterestRateApplicableIndicator
	,BDGAC.APY_PCNT AS AnnualPercentageYield
	,BDGAC.INT_COMPOUNDING_FRQ_CR AS InterestCompoundingFrequencyId
	,BDGAC.INT_COMPOUNDING_REST_FLG_CR AS InterestCompoundingRestIndicator
	,BDGAC.DISC_RATE_FLG_CR AS DiscountedRateIndicator
	,BDGAC.KONFORMNA_FLG AS KonformnaIndicator
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GAC BDGAC ON BDG.ACID = BDGAC.ACID AND BDG.BANK_ID = BDGAC.BANK_ID AND BDGAC.ISLATEST = 1
)

FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccount_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccount_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CoreCustomerAccount_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)
